title: Bitku
description:
Feature List

• Create with Constraints: Choose a theme and draw 10 random cards, your entire toolbox for building a story. Combine these into a 1 to 4 panel story using backgrounds, objects, and multi-frame elements.

• Remix Everything: Customize freely with text, recoloring, scaling, and rotation tools.

• Endless Variety: Every run generates new combinations, leading to strange, funny, or unexpected results.

• Export & Share: Save your creations as PNGs and share them anywhere.

Explore a World of Pixels

Bitku is a simple storyteller, a short comic creator, and a strange little art toy. It doesn’t try to be just one thing, and that’s the point. Start by choosing a theme, then draw 10 random cards. Each card gives you a piece of your story: a background, an object, or something a little stranger. From there, build a 1–4 panel comic using only what you’ve been given.

The magic of BITKU comes from limitation. With a small, random set of elements, you’re pushed to think differently, combining ideas, bending meaning, and discovering stories you wouldn’t have planned. Sometimes your comic will be funny, sometimes surreal, and sometimes it won’t make sense at all.

But that’s part of it.Once your story is complete, you can fully customize it, add dialogue, change colors, resize and rotate elements, then export it as a PNG to share with the world.

BITKU is completely free. No unlocks, no upgrades, no barriers. Just open it up and start making something strange.
description_short: Create strange and charming pixel comics in this totally free free-for-all art game. Choose a theme, draw cards, and build your own story. Is Bitku a simple storyteller, a comic creator, an art toy, or a new way to express yourself in pixels? Find out for yourself.
